user.title: Connect to Freebox
user.description: Enter your Freebox address. If you haven't changed it, leave the default value.

authorize.title: Freebox Authorization
authorize.description:
1. Go to your Freebox Server unit.
2. Press the **right arrow** on the display to approve the access request (HA CallerID).
3. Return here and click **Submit**.

⚠️ Important: Once completed, go to Freebox OS > Settings > Access Management > Applications, and check **Access to call log** for HA CallerID.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: Freebox Caller ID needs to re-authenticate access to your Freebox.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Freebox.
error.auth_failed: The Freebox rejected the authorization request.
error.pending_auth: The authorization has not yet been confirmed on the Freebox.
error.auth_denied: The authorization request was denied or expired.

init.title: Freebox Caller ID Options
init.description: Adjust polling frequency and ringing timeout.

data_description.scan_interval:
A polling interval that is too fast (e.g. 1s) responds quicker but may overload the box.
2 seconds is the default value in order to limit the ring-detection latency. A higher value reduces the number of requests sent to the Freebox, at the expense of detection speed.
data_description.ringing_timeout: Sets the 'ringing' sensor activation duration; defaults to 45s. Answering the phone overrides this setting.
